attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Adds a WrapObjectHandler in Jint to properly unwrap JsonDynamicObject/Array/Value for JS interop, a targeted fix with fallback to default wrapping and added test coverage, but changes core JavaScript scripting engine behavior used across all tenants/modules so subtle interop regressions for other object types are possible."}

reason: Adds a WrapObjectHandler in Jint to properly unwrap JsonDynamicObject/Array/Value for JS interop, a targeted fix with fallback to default wrapping and added test coverage, but changes core JavaScript scripting engine behavior used across all tenants/modules so subtle interop regressions for other object types are possible.
